verdict.rationale: No evidence of any API, CLI, or headless/programmatic interface for NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook; all documented usage is through the interactive web UI (upload, chat, generate audio/video overviews, etc.). Community comments even note manual workarounds (e.g., using gyb/mhonarc externally) rather than any automation hooks, reinforcing the lack of CI/headless support.
